character_sheet: Mobzilla (the `godzilla` registry) is the mod's largest boss, a 25-block bipedal kaiju: a three-block body under a spined back, a neck to a head with an upper and a hinged lower jaw, two arms of shoulder, upper arm, forearm and a three-fingered hand, two legs of thigh, upper leg and lower leg on three-toed feet, and an eight-segment tail with spines (ModelGodzilla.createBodyLayer, ModelGodzilla.java:168-537). It has 4000 HP, 175 attack and 21 armour (MobStats.GODZILLA, createAttributes Godzilla.java:148-155; a 6000 constant gates its healing, :66, :311-313), a purple boss bar (:86-87) and four manual hitbox parts that ride the root — bodyLow 8x8, bodyUp 6x6, head 5x5, tail 4x4 (:129-133, :292-295; the head takes full damage, the bodies half, the tail a quarter plus one, :262-270). It wanders and looks at anything living within 50 blocks (:140-145). Its AI (customServerAiStep :655-814) reloads eight cannon shots every 100 ticks, picks a target on a 1-in-5 tick and, by distance and dice: calls lightning on it (100 damage, fire, an explosion and two bolts, :769-770, doLightningAttack :560-578), leaps at it (jumpAtEntity :391-403), closes within seventeen blocks with the attacking flag up and stomps it (:777-784, doHurtTarget :819-847: a 3.2 knockback, and a big creature halved), or beyond 25 blocks fires a volley — a really big fireball and five more from the mouth 22 blocks ahead and 19 up (fireCannon :516-556). Every landing from a jump rings damage out to 10, 15 and 25 blocks (:699-710, doJumpDamage :490-512), and it crushes blocks around and ahead of itself while it walks (:712-733). Damage to it is capped and refused for 20 ticks after each hit (hurt :851-879); it heals 5 on a 1-in-35 roll (:811-813), never falls or burns by lightning (:315-326), and spawns once per world by night above y 50 under open sky on a 1-in-40 roll with a clear 17x11x17 pocket and no other within 64 blocks (checkSpawnRules :184-214) in the Village biome (village_biome.json), calling up its invisible gaze-tracking head sidecar at its first target (:756-763). Read it as slow and vast: every step plants, the arms swing wide when it rages, the tail lashes.
size_notes: Drawn at x2.0 of the rig, a quarter of that while PlayNicely (GodzillaRenderer.java:25, applied :34-40; shadow 1.0 x 2.0) on a 1024x1024 sheet (ModelGodzilla.java:537); 9.9 x 25 block hitbox (ModEntities.java:188-193; 2.475 x 6.25 while PlayNicely, Godzilla.getDefaultDimensions :254-259; the design's row writes [10,25]). The four manual part hitboxes are placed from the root position, not from the pose (:292-295) — until the bone-synced profile lands, the head's and tail's hit surfaces do not move with your keys. The arms, legs and tail are chains the code positions segment by segment — key the joints, never the positions.

groups.name: gait
groups.axis: x, with the foot's slide (z) and lift (y)
groups.amplitude: x the walking speed, zero below a limbSwingAmount of 0.001: the foot (nine toe pieces) slides 35 units fore-aft with the wave and lifts 18 units on the forward half (sin > 0); the lower leg rides the foot and pitches pi x 0.09 = 0.283 rad (16 deg) about 0.22; the upper leg pitches pi x 0.15 = 0.471 rad (27 deg) about −0.17 on a wave 45 degrees ahead and is placed 55 units up the lower leg; the thigh pitches pi x 0.1 = 0.314 rad (18 deg) about −0.558, 45 degrees ahead, and slides 35/4 units; the right leg half a period behind the left
groups.plain: each leg strides as a planted foot that slides back and lifts forward, the lower leg following it and the upper leg and thigh swinging a quarter turn ahead; the right leg opposite the left
groups.math: c = cos(t * 0.75), c2 = cos(t * 0.75 + pi/4), s = sin(t * 0.75) (right: + pi, + 5pi/4, + pi); LToe*.z = 6 + 35 c amount; LToe*.y = s > 0 ? 16 - s * 18 * amount : 16; LLowerLeg = the foot's position, xRot 0.22 + c * pi * 0.09 * amount; LUpperLeg.xRot = -0.17 + c2 * pi * 0.15 * amount (placed 55 up the lower leg by cos/sin); LThigh.xRot = -0.558 + c2 * pi * 0.1 * amount, z = 2 + 35 c amount / 4
groups.omega_note: the classic phase is ageInTicks x 0.75 (ANIM_SPEED 1.0): the natural period is 2 pi / 0.75 = 8.38 ticks

groups.name: tail
groups.amplitude: calm: pi x 0.05 = 0.157 rad (9 deg) at 0.75 rad/tick; attacking: pi x 0.2 = 0.628 rad (36 deg) at 1.75 rad/tick; scaled 0.25 / 0.5 / 0.75 / 1.25 / 1.5 / 1.75 / 2 / 2.25 along the eight segments (the tip 81 deg attacking), each placed at the end of the one before; the spines ride their segments
groups.plain: the tail sways in phase along its length, the tip swinging nine times the base — a slow sweep at rest, a fast lash while attacking
groups.math: a = attacking ? cos(t * 1.75) * pi * 0.2 : cos(t * 0.75) * pi * 0.05; TailBase.yRot = Lspike5 = Rspike5 = 0.25a; Tail2 = 0.5a; Tail3 = 0.75a; Tail4 = 1.25a; Tail5 = 1.5a; Tail6 = 1.75a; Tail7 = 2a; TailTip = 2.25a; positions along the chain by cos/sin x 25 / 20 / 20 / 25 / 27 / 28 / 18
groups.phase: the synced DATA_ATTACKING byte (Godzilla.java:83; set at :779 / :790, cleared at :799 / :802 / :806) selects the rhythm
groups.omega_note: the classic phase calm is ageInTicks x 0.75 (period 8.38 ticks); attacking x 1.75 (period 3.59 ticks)

groups.name: arms
groups.amplitude: attacking: a sine of pi x 0.16 = 0.503 rad (29 deg) at 1.75 rad/tick; calm: pi x 0.02 = 0.063 rad (3.6 deg) at 0.1 rad/tick; the upper arm takes the wave about ±0.65, the forearm 1.5x about ±0.78, the hand 2x about 1.308 / −2.0, the index finger 2x, the thumb 1x, the third finger 3x, each placed at the end of the segment before; the right arm the negative

groups.name: jaw
groups.amplitude: attacking: pi x 0.12 = 0.377 rad (22 deg) about 0.52 plus the head's pitch; calm: still at 0.52 plus the pitch

behaviour: One speed-scaled stride at 0.75 rad/tick (an 8.4-tick period): each foot — nine toe pieces moved as one — slides 35 units back and forth with the wave and lifts 18 units on its forward half, the lower leg rides it and pitches 16 degrees, the upper leg and thigh swing 27 and 18 degrees a quarter turn ahead, and the right leg runs half a period behind the left (ModelGodzilla.java:553-623). Standing still every leg rests.

The tail sways in phase along eight segments, the tip nine times the base: 9 degrees at 0.75 rad/tick at rest, 36 degrees at 1.75 rad/tick while the synced DATA_ATTACKING byte is set (Godzilla.java:83; raised at :779 within seventeen blocks and at :790 when the cannon is aimed) (:625-630, :707-747).

The arms swing about the vertical with the hands and fingers opening and closing — 3.6 degrees at 0.1 rad/tick at rest, 29 degrees at 1.75 rad/tick attacking, wider at every joint out (:647-704); the lower jaw chomps 22 degrees at 1.5 rad/tick while attacking (:641-645). The head turns 0.55 of the look yaw and pitches with the look, the jaws with it (:632-639).
The body blocks, neck, shoulders and the back and crest spines are static; the walk position plays no part.

The stomp (doHurtTarget, Godzilla.java:819-847), the leap (jumpAtEntity :391-403), the landing rings (:699-710), the cannon volley (fireCannon :516-556) and the lightning (doLightningAttack :560-578) are all rolled by customServerAiStep (:655-814) — nothing in the code fires an animation for any of them; the four manual part hitboxes are placed from the root each tick (:292-295).

locked_bones_note: The design's section 6 ModelGodzilla row (geckolib_migration_design.md:448): 'Start from current envelopes: BodyBottom [8,8] @0.5; BodyTop [6,6] @0.5; Head [5,5] @1; TailBase [4,4] @0.25; add Tail4 [3,3] @0.25, TailTip [2,2] @0.25, left/right thigh/lower-leg segments [3,7] @0.5, and hands [2,2] @0.25'. BodyBottom, BodyTop, Head, TailBase, Tail4 and TailTip resolve as written. 'left/right thigh/lower-leg segments' is not a bone name: taken as LThigh / RThigh and the lower legs, which the port names asymmetrically — LLowerLeg on the left and RLegLower on the right (ModelGodzilla.createBodyLayer; likewise LUpperLeg / RLegUpper); the upper legs are not named by the row and stay visual. 'hands' taken as LHand / RHand (the fingers stay visual). The four manual OreSpawnPartEntity parts (bodyLow 8x8, bodyUp 6x6, head 5x5, tail 4x4 — Godzilla.java:129-133) are the envelopes the row starts from and keeps live until cutover; the row writes the main size as [10,25] against the registered 9.9 x 25.
